examples.text: Two Harbor & Pine coffee tins side by side, standing upright, seen from a low hero angle, on a breakfast table with a plate of croissants and a jug of milk, sunny dining room blurred behind. Format 1:1. Leave calm space at the top for a headline.

examples.text: Two Harbor & Pine coffee tins side by side, standing upright, seen at eye level, on a warm oak kitchen counter next to a pour-over coffee maker and a mug, pale tiles behind, soft morning window light. Format 4:5. Leave calm space at the top for a headline.

issues.layout_first: No significant issues; the product is accurately rendered and well-integrated.
issues.swap: The tins lack 3D shading and appear as flat, unlit cutouts pasted into the scene.
